selection_disclosure: Primary is retrospective; secondary was the historical test-F1 maximum. Neither is an unbiased confirmatory model selection estimate.
threshold_policy: dev maximum F1; ties by precision, recall, accuracy, then lower threshold; test fixed; no additional rounding
prior_policy: Unsmoothed dev error prevalence by pre-annotated fact type; unseen types use overall dev prevalence. This is an annotation-composition diagnostic, not an information-matched detector: types are manually supplied and names such as malformed_number and unsupported_business_claim already convey correctness hints.

bootstrap.policy: Paired test-cluster percentile differences; both methods recomputed on each identical draw; dev fits held fixed. Conditional on provisional labels, not selection-adjusted. Period components join overlapping months transitively.

signal_interpretation.max_selected_step_energy_gap: Mathematically max token NLL; floating-point alias audit, not independent evidence for an energy family.
signal_interpretation.mean_spilled_probability_mass_after_top2: Probability concentration control, not proof of a distinct energy mechanism.
signal_interpretation.negative_mean_spilled_energy_delta: Opposite orientation control of the same signed statistic.
signal_interpretation.adjacent_step_energy: Retained as historical diagnostics; paper-formula fidelity and time-index audit remain Stage F.

missing_question_policy: q_0048 is dev and has no spans. Do not infer labels or correctness. B2 must separately add reviewed labels and study threshold sensitivity.
probability_provenance: Raw teacher-forced forward logits after generation, not the temperature/top-p/top-k sampling distribution. Saved float32 values are aggregated without additional decimal rounding; original logit precision is not recovered.
